title: Business Intelligence — semantic models, reports, dashboards
description: Intent-scoped fabio skill for the Fabric BI layer: semantic models (datasets), Power BI reports, paginated reports, and dashboards. Use for creating/refreshing semantic models, running DAX, and managing report items. Triggers: "semantic model", "dataset", "dax query", "refresh dataset", "power bi report", "paginated report", "dashboard", "direct lake".
when_to_use: Bounded read-only BI readiness: model schema, opt-in selected-table data counts, exact refresh request completion and report binding without resubmitting refreshes or changing modes.
Optimizing a semantic model / checking it against best practices (semantic-model analyze — Best Practice Analyzer over INFO.VIEW; measure-dependencies for AI data schema scoping).
Creating native Direct Lake models from known compatible Delta table URLs, or choosing schema-aware generation from a lakehouse/warehouse without hand-authored TMDL.
Creating/updating semantic models from TMDL and binding them to a SQL endpoint.
Running DAX queries (EVALUATE) and refreshing models.
Creating/managing reports, paginated reports, and dashboards bound to a model.
Building Direct Lake reports over lakehouse Delta tables.
when_not_to_use: Building the underlying lakehouse/warehouse data -> use fabio-lakehouse or fabio-warehouse-sql.
Natural-language Q&A over data (fabio's AI analog) -> use the data-agent group / app-developer persona.
must: Treat 'dataset' as a semantic model (use the semantic-model group, NOT report); see 'fabio context disambiguate semantic-model'.

Choose the model creation mode first: native --one-lake-table, an explicitly empty model, an authored --definition folder/one --file, or schema-aware generate. Preserve an authored folder's source expressions. --connection is not a universal prerequisite and is rejected for native/empty creation; see bi-creation.

Validate a PBIR/PBIP report folder offline with 'report validate --source <folder>' before 'report create --definition' or deploy — it catches missing required files, bad $schema, and byPath-vs-byConnection issues without a tenant call.
prefer: semantic-model analyze (--with-cardinality, --severity, --strict) to check a model against best practices before shipping or using it as a data-agent source — it flags missing descriptions, cryptic names, implicit aggregation on identifier columns, duplicate measures, ambiguous dates, relationship hygiene, non-star schemas, calculated + high-cardinality columns. Add --fix to auto-apply the ONE safe mechanical fix (set default summarization to None on identifier columns) via a dry-run-guarded definition overwrite; naming/dedup/schema/description issues are NOT auto-fixed (they need human judgment). Use semantic-model measure-dependencies to include every dependent measure/column when scoping an AI data schema. See 'fabio context best-practices semantic-model-optimization'.

Native semantic-model create --one-lake-table for known compatible Delta sources when no local definition is needed. Use generate --lakehouse (or --warehouse) for schema-aware definition generation, including schema-less lakehouses; it reads SQL metadata, maps types, and requests framing. Choose --storage-mode onelake for direct OneLake binding or sql (the default) for SQL-endpoint binding/DirectQuery fallback. These are explicit choices, not silent fallback modes. Relationships/measures are not inferred by the generator; inspect the resulting model before report design.

Introspect a model's schema with semantic-model list-tables/list-columns/list-measures/list-relationships (DAX INFO.VIEW.* — the Analysis Services Schema Rowsets) to understand tables, types, StorageMode (Direct Lake), measures, and relationships WITHOUT fetching/parsing the TMDL/TMSL definition.

report create --definition <folder> to create a FULL multi-page PBIR report from generated files (the documented, agent-authorable format); it gathers definition.pbir + report.json or definition/** and validates first. Use --dataset with it to rebind a byPath folder to a concrete model by connection.
Direct Lake over import mode when compatible Delta data already exists: it avoids importing data but still needs framing/readiness checks.
fabio rest call --api powerbi for Power BI-specific endpoints not on the Fabric surface.
semantic-model query --dax for validation before wiring a report.
avoid: Inventing a 'fabio dataset' command — datasets are semantic models.
Repeating --file to import a multi-file model (use --definition), or treating a native empty report as a finished dashboard.

Feeding a byPath definition.pbir to 'report create' without --dataset (byPath needs a co-deployed model; 'deploy' rewrites byPath→byConnection automatically, but 'report create' needs byConnection — pass --dataset to bind by id).
key_gotchas: refresh exposes a submission receipt; generate exposes the same structure as framing. Capture top-level refreshId only with correlationStatus:verified (a validated exact-scope Location, never followed). Transport trace x-ms-request-id alone, malformed/missing/conflicting headers and latest history are NOT operation identity. completionStatus is not_checked even when acknowledgement/correlation succeeded.

Unreadable successful refresh responses preserve acknowledgement/verified headers; do not resubmit. Error-bearing success and uncertain network/server failures stay unknown (the latter are non-retriable). generate preserves the created model and sanitized framing.state unknown/rejected/skipped instead of asking for a blind retry. Legacy framed:true means acknowledged, not complete; false does not prove an unknown request was rejected.

semantic-model readiness --workspace <WS> --id <MODEL> checks model/schema visibility only by default. Repeat --expected-table (at most 20) to assert model tables; --probe-data opts into COUNTROWS and --min-rows 1 requires each table to be nonempty (default minimum 0). Reads may consume capacity and prove only current-caller counts, NOT Delta compatibility, freshness, source grants for others or exact storage/fallback mode.

Readiness --refresh-id observes an EXACT request, preferably using the verified submission/framing receipt's refreshId. It never selects latest history or resubmits work. If no verified ID is exposed, compare refresh-status against the pre-submission baseline and select one unambiguous new request; an old Completed request is not proof of the new one. Failed/cancelled/disabled selected refresh stops --wait, even when schema queries work.

Readiness --report-id [--report-workspace] compares the report's Power BI datasetId with the selected model. Matching binding is not proof of visuals/rendering/viewer access; no rebind, takeover or definition read/write occurs. Unreported dataset workspace is explicitly recorded, not invented.

Readiness --wait repeats only read-only observations, bounded by total --timeout including in-flight requests AND --max-attempts. --strict prints checks/notChecked then fails unless requested checks are ready. Missing, malformed, truncated or unavailable evidence stays unknown. Omitted data/refresh/report checks are NOT established by a default ready status.

DAX queries and INFO.VIEW schema reads work with --readonly via the constrained executeQueries transport; other Power BI POST mutations remain blocked. Error-bearing/partial/malformed HTTP-200 query results fail, not empty success. Use --dry-run to preview readiness reads offline after scope validation.

connection diagnostics --workspace <WS> --item <MODEL_OR_REPORT> inspects only that item's exposed connection references. Automatic/SSO bindings can lack IDs, and a complete list is not proof that all external dependencies are exposed. Metadata/caller roles never prove credential health or workspace identity source authorization.

Capacity-specific refresh/query failures may suggest workspace diagnostics without automatically probing or changing policy. Remediation previews require confirmed evidence and approval; missing ARM/target identifiers are not guessed. See remediation-hints.
'dataset' (legacy Power BI term) == semantic model; Power BI REST still uses /datasets (reach it via rest call --api powerbi).

Schema introspection uses DAX INFO.VIEW.* (list-tables/columns/measures/relationships) over the same executeQueries endpoint as query --dax; the raw INFO.TABLES()/INFO.COLUMNS() variants are rejected by executeQueries (HTTP 400) — only INFO.VIEW.* works.

PBIR (the enhanced per-file 'definition/' folder) is Microsoft's documented, agent-authorable report format (each page/visual has its own $schema-bearing JSON) and becomes the only format at GA; conform to the published visual.json/page.json schemas and run 'report validate' before create/deploy. fabio 'report create --definition' pushes a full PBIR tree (previously only 'deploy' could).
Direct Lake reads Delta directly — the report is empty until the lakehouse tables are populated.

Native model creation and schema-less compatibility are covered by bi-creation: no local definition or --connection for empty/--one-lake-table creation, and no silent switch to the generator after DirectLakeSchemaError.

report create --semantic-model creates an EMPTY bound report, optionally across workspaces via --semantic-model-workspace. For pages/visuals use report scaffold and validate/publish the PBIR folder with --definition and --dataset. Native --semantic-model is not an alias for --dataset in scaffold or definition import. Inspect stored format before enhanced-PBIR-only editing.

Creation is not query readiness. semantic-model refresh returns refresh_triggered; poll the NEW refresh via refresh-status with a deadline, then verify tables and a DAX read. Never resubmit refresh in a polling loop or use takeover/--allow-purge-data as an automatic workaround.

Both semantic-model generate storage modes read SQL metadata over TDS and need SQL-audience credentials from the credential chain or FABIO_SQL_ACCESS_TOKEN, not a Fabric-only static token. The generator emits multi-file Direct Lake TMDL and requests Full framing unless --no-refresh is supplied; use bounded refresh/query verification rather than a fixed sleep as proof of readiness. Fresh Delta tables can lag before appearing on the SQL endpoint. --storage-mode sql emits Sql.Database(server, <sqlEndpointId>) with schemaName on partitions. --storage-mode onelake emits AzureStorage.DataLake("https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<workspaceId>/<itemId>") and drops schemaName for schema-less lakehouses (kept for warehouses/schema-enabled lakehouses, detected via properties.defaultSchema). The output storageMode is directLakeOnSql or directLakeOnOneLake.

To edit individual model objects fabio uses definition read-modify-write (getDefinition->edit TMDL->updateDefinition), NOT XMLA/TOM: set-description; measures add/update/delete/rename/move (rename does NOT rewrite DAX references; move changes the home table); columns add-calculated-column/delete/rename/update-column (rename preserves a calculated column's = expr but does NOT rewrite references); hierarchies add-hierarchy/delete-hierarchy/list-hierarchies (drill-down levels inside the table); partitions add-partition/update-partition/delete-partition/list-partitions (a table's data-source queries; update-partition repoints the M/DAX source; a table must keep >=1); calculation groups add-calculation-group/add-calculation-item/update-calculation-item/delete-calculation-group/delete-calculation-item/list-calculation-groups (time-intelligence; the model auto-gets discourageImplicitMeasures); named expressions / Power Query parameters add-expression/update-expression/delete-expression/list-expressions (in definition/expressions.tmdl; --parameter-value builds a PQ parameter; distinct from update-parameters which sets a DEPLOYED model's parameter values at runtime); DAX UDFs add-function/update-function/delete-function/list-functions (preview; auto-bumps compatibilityLevel to 1702; add-function/update-function accept --description → emitted as `///` comment lines above the function in functions.tmdl, surfaced by list-functions and carried through getDefinition/Git — update-function with --description replaces it in place, an empty string clears it; the DAX expression can use optional params with defaults, e.g. `(x: NUMERIC = 1, y: NUMERIC = 2) => x + y`, invoked as AddNum(), AddNum(10,5)); perspectives add-perspective/delete-perspective/add-perspective-member/remove-perspective-member/list-perspectives (filtered model views); tables add-table (calculated, DAX expression)/delete-table (CASCADES: also removes relationships + role RLS filters referencing the table)/rename-table (moves the file + updates the model.tmdl ref); relationships add/delete/update (in definition/relationships.tmdl, match by --relationship-id or the full from/to column tuple); security roles + RLS via add-role/delete-role/set-rls/delete-rls/list-roles (RLS filters are a DAX predicate per table; distinct from add-user which grants dataset permissions to a principal); translations via add-culture/set-translation/delete-culture/list-cultures (multi-language captions per table/column/measure in definition/cultures/<c>.tmdl). These OVERWRITE the definition (irreversible, dry-run guarded); a child object lands after the table scalar props (canonical measures-first) so it does not break TMDL indentation.

PBIR page/visual authoring is a definition read-modify-write (like semantic models): report list-pages/list-visuals to inspect; add-page/delete-page/rename-page/set-active-page and add-visual/delete-visual to edit; report get-settings/set-setting read+write report-level settings (report.json ExplorationSettings: hideVisualContainerHeader, filterPaneHiddenInEditMode, allowInlineExploration, isPersistentUserStateDisabled, useCrossReportDrillthrough, … — set-setting enumerates valid names and takes true/false for booleans; it fails fast on an unknown name before any network call); report scaffold --spec generates a whole report from a compact {pages:[{visuals:[...]}]} JSON. Field specs use Table.Column DOT form (Sales.Amount, NOT Sales[Amount]); measures wrap an aggregation like Sum(Sales.Amount). add-visual/scaffold need --dataset pointing at a REAL semantic model (placeholder id -> PowerBIEntityNotFound). All these editors REQUIRE enhanced PBIR: a PBIR-Legacy report (single report.json, e.g. from a bare 'report create --dataset') is rejected — 'report validate' flags it with a PBIR_LEGACY_DEPRECATED warning (PBIR becomes the only format at GA). Convert to PBIR (open+save in the service) first. All edits overwrite the definition (destructive); run report validate after editing.

Direct Lake models (incl. every 'semantic-model generate' output) REJECT calculated columns: 'add-calculated-column' fails on a Direct Lake table, and 'add-calculation-group' needs its partition set to mode:import (fabio does this automatically). To add computed logic to a Direct Lake model, use measures/DAX UDFs, or compute the column upstream in the lakehouse/warehouse. A hand-authored Direct Lake table carrying a calculated column will fail updateDefinition validation.

Semantic-model create and update-definition accept --allow-purge-data, which sends options.allowPurgeData=true. Some definition changes require purging incompatible existing data; this is irreversible for data that cannot be retained, so refresh the model afterward and require explicit approval before using it.

Copilot-powered read commands consume the REMOTE Power BI MCP server (need the PowerBIMCP tenant setting ON): 'semantic-model generate-dax --prompt' (NL->DAX, --execute to run it), 'semantic-model copilot-schema' (the Copilot-oriented schema + AI/custom instructions that INFO.VIEW.* can't surface), 'report copilot-metadata' (synthesized report schema: pages/visuals/field bindings/PromptInstructions). When PowerBIMCP is disabled the error NAMES the setting; fall back to 'semantic-model query --dax' / 'list-tables' / 'report get-definition'.

'semantic-model evaluate-measure --measure <m> [--group-by Table.Column] [--top N]' evaluates measures without hand-writing DAX (the semantic-link evaluate_measure equivalent) — it builds ROW/SUMMARIZECOLUMNS/TOPN and runs it via executeQueries.

troubleshooting.fix: Check the chosen creation mode (bi-creation). Native/empty modes reject --connection. Inspect native Delta-source schema/access or preserve the authored definition's actual source expressions; do not blindly add a connection or change binding mode.

troubleshooting.symptom: report create --definition rejected / opaque API error
troubleshooting.fix: Run 'fabio report validate --source <folder>' first; conform each PBIR file to its published $schema and ensure required files (definition.pbir, definition/{report,version}.json, pages/**/page.json) are present.
For Direct Lake, populate the lakehouse tables first; for import, refresh the model. For a hand-authored PBIR folder, validate it and conform visual.json to the published visual container schema.
Resume the capacity (fabio capacity resume) before refreshing.
Use the semantic-model group; 'dataset' is the legacy name for a semantic model.

safety: Refreshing a large model consumes capacity — confirm headroom before a full refresh.
Overwriting a semantic model definition replaces its measures/relationships — confirm with the user.

semantic-model analyze --fix overwrites the model definition (irreversible) to apply the safe summarization fix — it is dry-run guarded; preview with --dry-run first. It only changes default summarization on identifier columns, never renames or restructures.
